features: Seamless Multi-Device Connectivity : This bluetooth keyboard and mouse combo connects up to 3 devices — via 1× USB 2.4GHz and 2× Bluetooth — letting you switch effortlessly between your laptop, tablet, and desktop for a smooth, uninterrupted wireless keyboard and mouse experience.

Silent and Comfortable Typing : Tear-drop concave scissor keys combined with Huano silent switches deliver a quiet, tactile typing experience — making this keyboard and mouse for laptop use perfect for shared workspaces, libraries, and noise-sensitive environments.

Productivity-Boosting Shortcuts : Dedicated buttons for AI assistants (Copilot, Siri, Gemini), Emoji, Screenshots, Calculator, and multimedia keys put your most-used tools at your fingertips — enhancing productivity with this wireless keyboard and mouse combo.
Fn Lock for Customized Typing : Seamlessly toggle between Function and Multimedia keys with Fn Lock, giving you a flexible keyboard mouse setup that adapts to your unique workflow and preferences.

Wide OS Compatibility : This keyboard mouse wireless combo works effortlessly with Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android — delivering a truly hassle-free keyboard and mouse experience across all your devices.
